h1: What is the difference between a Massachusetts CSL and HIC license?
title: Massachusetts CSL vs. HIC Registration: Construction Oversight and Consumer Protection
description: Understand the different purposes of a Construction Supervisor License and Home Improvement Contractor registration.
short_answer: A Massachusetts Construction Supervisor License (CSL) concerns supervision of construction work regulated by the building code. Home Improvement Contractor (HIC) registration is a separate consumer-protection registration for contractors doing covered home-improvement work. A project may involve both requirements, so homeowners should not treat one credential as a substitute for the other.

facts.text: Massachusetts says certain construction projects require oversight by a licensed construction supervisor or registered design professional.
Massachusetts HIC rules separately regulate contractor registration, written contracts, permits, payments, and access to the Guaranty Fund.

qa.q: Does an HIC registration replace a CSL?
qa.a: No. The CSL and HIC programs address different requirements: construction supervision under the building code and contractor registration under the home-improvement law.
